notes: Overall: avg 4.0 with nothing below 4 (rc.3 was 3.83). This clears the bar, but only just. I applied rc.3's standard: every rc.3 state and polish blocker I could verify is fixed, and what remains is small. Four of the remaining items are agent misses of rules the spec already states (badge spacing, a bare green status word, mono in spec rows and counts, 3:2 grid frames). They are listed under promptFixes for the next version. None of them alone would make a design lead reject the release.

rc.3 dark segmented selection: FIXED. Dashboard 'All' (desktop and mobile dark) and commerce 'Natural' / 'S' (tote desktop dark, merino mobile dark) are now a lighter #38362f segment with a visible ring on the darker track.
rc.3 light card hover: FIXED. On commerce state-card-hover, light and dark, the hovered card gets a clearly visible tertiary ring and an underlined title.
rc.3 native search clear: FIXED. Blog state-search-empty (desktop and mobile) and dashboard state-search-focus / state-empty-filter show no blue cancel x.
rc.3 nav focus ring touching text: FIXED. Blog 'Home', commerce 'Cart' and dashboard 'Projects' are padded boxes with clear space around the glyphs. The settings sidebar 'Security' ring is also good.

rc.3 bare 'Saved' word: FIXED on desktop (success badge with a check, about 12px after Reset). New mobile problem: on state-profile-saved-mobile-light the badge is pushed into the fixed action bar. Save shrinks from about 280 to 200 CSS px, the bar holds three items, and the badge sits about 12px from the viewport edge.

rc.3 top-aligned dialog: FIXED. The plan dialog is centered in the viewport on desktop light and dark and on mobile, Cancel shows its focus ring, there is a close x, and on mobile the buttons are full width with the primary on top.

rc.3 'All projects' under 'Projects': FIXED (now visually hidden). New side effect: the projects card now opens with a lone 'Showing 8 of 8 projects' at top left, then about 40px of empty space, then a toolbar whose 'Filter projects' label sits on its own line above the input while the segmented control has no label. The card header reads as unfinished, about 125px of chrome before the first row.
rc.3 'Current plan' pill looking like a button: FIXED. It is a 22px neutral badge in the Pro card header, and Pro is the lifted card.
rc.3 mobile TOC before the h1: FIXED. 'On this page' is a closed details element after the tags (release-notes mobile).

rc.3 half-empty cards: FIXED for forms. The security password card shrinks to the form, profile uses 2 field columns in 8 columns, and the Apollo spec rows' hairlines span the card. The Apollo values column still leaves about 60% of the card blank to the right, which is acceptable for key/value rows.

rc.3 mobile save bar inside the card: FIXED. It is a full-width fixed bar and the card reserves no space. New: the bar ground (color.surface.bar, #faf9f6f0, 94% opacity) lets text show through. Faint 'Product manager' (state-profile-errors-mobile) and Bio glyphs (state-profile-saved-mobile) are visible behind and between the buttons.

rc.3 table column jumps: FIXED. Dashboard state-search-focus (1 result) keeps Owner at x=840 and the other columns identical to the full table. New and spec-caused: 'the primary column takes the rest' leaves a large void inside the row. Projects names end around x=230 but Owner starts at x=840. Team names end around x=280 but Role starts at x=912. Billing invoice IDs end at x=410 but Date starts at x=811. The rows read as two separate clusters.

rc.3 badge touching its label: NOT FIXED (agent miss; the spec now gives 'margin-left: space.8'). On settings-security desktop light and dark, and in state-password-mismatch, 'Chrome on Windows' ends at x=470 and the 'This device' badge starts at x=472. The badge also sits about 1px low. On mobile dark the gap is about 3px.

rc.3 loud hatch: FIXED. On commerce home light the hatch reads as paper texture and is quieter than the eyebrows and titles. Dark is subtle. The blog figure frames are calm. Remaining spec miss: the commerce grid frames are 4:3 (316x236) although the spec says 3:2 in a grid of 3 or more asset-less frames. The agent report says it applied 4:3 'per the spec', so the media-frame ratio sentence reads ambiguously.

rc.3 mono zero inside a sentence: FIXED. 'Showing 0 of 6 posts', 'Showing 0 of 8 projects' and '3 of 6 notifications on' are all sans. New inconsistencies in the other direction (agent misses of rule 7): commerce spec rows '40 x 35 x 15 cm', '18 oz' and '100% merino wool' are fully sans, the Team 'Active projects' cell numbers are sans, and the Apollo 'Files 3' value is sans while Budget and Due date in the same card are mono.

rc.3 note contradictions: FIXED. The store note 'made for every day' restates the lead and lands on 'every day.'. Settings 'all your settings' stays inside the sidebar, and its arrow points up at the nav list. Dashboard 'this month so far' lands on 'October 2026.'. Blog 'our pick' lands about 12px from the featured card's right edge.

Other rc.3 fixes checked: commerce home-mobile-light.png is now 780px wide (the old 828px anomaly is gone). The mobile sort chips show the selected 'Due date' chip in view (projects-mobile light and dark). The blog article title now breaks 'Writing Release Notes / People Actually Read' with no widow.

New component-state findings: (1) Dashboard state-row-hover-desktop-dark: the hover row is barely distinguishable, because subtle #24231f at 50% over raised #1d1c18 is about 1.05:1. The light version is fine. (2) Settings state-password-mismatch: 'Strength: Strong' is a bare green word, and the Never list forbids success shown as a bare colored word. It also replaces the 'Use at least 8 characters' hint. (3) Textarea resize grabbers are the browser default on checkout, profile and bio. That is acceptable but unstyled. Strong: checkout, profile and password error states (counted danger callout, icon plus message, first invalid field focused), the toast with an action (commerce add-to-cart), blog newsletter error and success, empty states (blog search, dashboard filter, cart), the dark switch, the user menu sheet, and the disabled stepper minus.

Hierarchy elsewhere is clear. Every landing screen reads h1, then lead, then content. KPIs outweigh the chart. The billing lifted Pro card plus badge reads correctly with no primary CTA, and the checkout callout is the first thing in the form. Minor: the dashboard chart card ends about 75px above Recent activity and leaves a dead strip, as noted in rc.3 and allowed by 'cards size to content'. The commerce header shows an ink count badge reading '0', a filled ink element announcing nothing.

Reference fidelity: unchanged from rc.3 and recognizable. It has the warm paper, the tracked grotesk with ink actions, chips, hairline cards, tape on the blog featured card, Caveat notes with hooked arrows, the one serif word with its swash on the blog masthead, and mono eyebrows and IDs. The bloom is still about a third of the reference p1 bloom, and in dark it reads as smoky grey-blue rather than watercolor. That is acceptable for an app header. It is not a copy: no logo, copy or imagery carried over.

Cross-app: one family. The four apps share the same header height and hairline, h1 and lead rhythm, card radius, badge and chip language, error-callout pattern (commerce and both settings forms), dialog and toast tone, and dark palette. Spec-sanctioned divergences: success is a callout (blog), a toast (commerce) or a badge (settings), and mobile nav is inline links (blog, commerce) or a menu sheet (dashboard, settings). Dashboard and settings rows use a status badge with a dot while blog tags use plain neutral badges, which is consistent.

Capture harness (process, not template): full-page captures keep position:fixed elements at the first viewport. The mobile action bar sits mid-page and hides the merino 'Details' heading and the profile Bio label. The mobile dialog capture shows the sticky header and the scrim band halfway down the page, and the desktop dialog scrim stops at y=900. These are capture artifacts, not layout bugs, but they make published gallery shots look broken.
promptFixes: Inline badge collision (agent miss; the rule exists only inside Badge Anatomy). Move it into the Never list: 'A badge touching the text before it: inline badges always have margin-left space.8 and vertical-align: middle.' Add to Verification: 'Every inline badge (This device, Sold out, status after h1) has at least 8px before it.'

Table void in the middle of rows (spec gap; caused by 'the primary column takes the rest'). In Table Anatomy, replace that clause with: 'Size the primary column to its content plus space.48 (minimum 240px, maximum 40% of the table); the last text column (or the actions column) absorbs the leftover width. No gap wider than 160px between the end of one column's content and the next column.' Add to Verification: 'No row has an empty band wider than 160px between columns.'

Translucent mobile action bar (spec gap). Change color.surface.bar to opaque (light #faf9f6, dark #151410), or require 'backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.2)' with the 94% ground. Add to Layout adaptation: 'No text behind the action bar may be readable through it.'

Success badge on mobile with a fixed action bar (spec gap). In Shared states, Success add: 'When the form actions live in the mobile action bar, the success badge sits in the page flow above the bar (bottom of the form card, role=status), or the confirmation becomes a toast above the bar; never a third item inside the bar.'

Bare colored status words other than 'Saved' (agent miss of the Never list; make it general). In Shared states add: 'Any status text the app renders in place (password strength, "Saved", "Verified") becomes a badge with an icon in its tone, or stays color.text.secondary text with a 12px icon; colored text alone is reserved for error messages.' Keep the field hint visible next to the strength badge.

Dark row hover (spec gap; the 50% subtle wash is about 1.05:1 in dark). In Table States change hover to: 'color.surface.subtle in light; in dark color.surface.selected at 60% (at least 1.15:1 against the row).' Add to Verification under Dark: 'row hover visible in a screenshot.'

Rule 7 coverage in spec rows and counts (agent miss; strengthen with examples). In rule 7 add: 'spec rows: "40 x 35 x 15 cm", "18 oz" and "100%" set their digits in mono; table count cells ("Active projects 2") and spec-row counts ("Files 3") are mono.' Add to Verification: 'Every digit in a table cell or spec row is mono; every digit in a sentence is sans.'

Grid placeholder ratio (spec ambiguity; the agent read 4:3 as binding). In Media frame Anatomy reorder to: 'Grids of 3 or more asset-less frames: 3:2 (this overrides the per-type ratio). Otherwise 4:3 products, 16:10 screenshots, 3:2 posts.'

Index-page table card header (spec gap, opened by the 'no title' rule). In Table or Typography add: 'A table card without a title starts with its toolbar row: filters left, search right, both size.control tall on one baseline, labels visually hidden or placeholder-only plus aria-label; the result count is a caption at the right end of the toolbar or directly above the first row. No standalone line above the toolbar.'
Count badge showing zero (spec gap). In Badge Variants, Count add: 'Hidden at 0; the header cart link shows the noun alone until there is at least 1 item.'

Mismatched column heights in a two-card row (minor spec gap). In Layout adaptation add: 'A chart card next to a list card in the same row shares its height (align-items: stretch) and centers the chart in the extra space; only cards of unrelated rows size to content.'

Harness (process). For full-page captures, either take a viewport-only capture for states with fixed overlays (dialog, toast, action bar), or before the capture set fixed and sticky elements to position:absolute at their scrolled position. Then gallery shots will not show a mid-page action bar or half-height scrims.
